_about: ElevenLabs sound-effect spec for Ghost Duels: one entry per file in ghost-duels-web/assets/sfx. 'use' is how game.js plays it (sound module, use(...) calls), 'gen' is the request, 'judge' the measurable bar a take must clear. See README.md in this folder.

defaults.key: A minor (game scale: A Phrygian; music: Spooky Carousel, A minor, ~96 BPM); wins resolve to A major
defaults.style: Cinematic orchestral (direction v4, 2026-11-11, README.md), matching the cinematic adventure score in A minor: celesta, harp, glockenspiel, plucked and tremolo strings, warm French horns and brass, taiko and timpani, a soft wordless choir, glassy spectral shimmer. Polished and premium, never horror. One room for everything: a torch-lit stone crypt with a short dark reverb (about 1 s). Musical parts on A (A minor; wins resolve to A major). No synths, no electronic or arcade sounds, no sub rumble, no piercing highs. Duels keep their fighting-game punch in orchestral textures. The tool sends prompts as written, so every prompt carries this palette itself.

sounds.name: click
sounds.role: Any button press (bet +/-, menus, autoplay, info).

prompts: Tiny premium UI click: an instant soft wooden tick with a tiny bright celesta glint on top. A hard transient at the very first millisecond, extremely short, dry, no fade-in, no reverb, no tail. Clean and polished.
Tiny premium UI click: an instant crisp tap of a small brass latch with a faint glassy ping. Starts at the very first millisecond, extremely short, dry, no reverb, no tail. Clean and polished.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: spin
sounds.role: Spin pressed: the old board falls out before the new symbols drop. Every round, thousands of times.

prompts: Slot spin start in a cinematic orchestral pirate crypt game: an instant soft taiko tap and a quick downward whoosh of air as the old symbols fall away, a light harp glissando downwards and a faint glassy spectral swirl. Warm, tight, under one second, not bright. Clean, polished, premium slot-game sound; one torch-lit stone crypt with a short dark reverb; no synths, no electronic or arcade bleeps, no harsh noise, no voices with words.

Slot spin start: an instant low muffled frame-drum hit, a short smooth downward whoosh and a quick descending pizzicato string run, soft and warm, under one second, not bright, subtle because it repeats every spin. Clean, polished, premium slot-game sound; one torch-lit stone crypt with a short dark reverb; no synths, no electronic or arcade bleeps, no harsh noise, no voices with words.

judge.note: not too bright: it repeats every spin

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: land
sounds.role: A reel comes to rest. 7 per spin, faster in turbo; the game raises it a little per reel.

prompts: A LOUD, close-up single knock of a hard wooden block struck with a mallet: one strong hit at full volume, warm mid-range tone like a woodblock or a low marimba bar, no second click, no rattle, very short, dry, starts instantly. Clean, punchy, clearly audible.

One single loud, punchy wooden thunk recorded close: a mallet hitting a thick hardwood slab, strong mid-range body around 400 Hz, one hit only, starts at the first millisecond and stops within a quarter of a second. Dry, clean, clearly audible.

judge.note: clean: one round knock, no second click (v3 round 2); needs mid-range, phone speakers drop the low thud

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

finish._why: v4 take 5 rings for 0.47 s; the old reel stop lasted 0.24 s and 7 play per spin

sounds.name: land_heavy
sounds.role: A VS reel or a ghost crate slams down (also under every crate landing in the bonus).

prompts: A heavy iron-bound treasure chest slamming onto crypt stone: an instant deep taiko and timpani hit with a short iron clank and a quick glassy spectral sparkle. Punchy, warm, under one second. Clean, polished, premium slot-game sound; one torch-lit stone crypt with a short dark reverb; no synths, no electronic or arcade bleeps, no harsh noise, no voices with words.

A huge carved stone reel slamming down: an instant orchestral bass drum and low brass stab with a short stone thud and a puff of shimmering spectral air. Punchy, cinematic, under one second. Clean, polished, premium slot-game sound; one torch-lit stone crypt with a short dark reverb; no synths, no electronic or arcade bleeps, no harsh noise, no voices with words.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: chime
sounds.role: Win arpeggios, small duel win.
sounds.note: Pitched note source: the game plays it as A5 and transposes it into the win arpeggios (2-5 notes, scale steps) and the small duel sting. apply retunes the take to the nearest A, so it must be one clear note.

prompts: One single clear celesta and glockenspiel note, pitch A5, soft attack, warm and round with a gentle glassy shimmer in the tail, short crypt reverb. One note only, no melody, clean, premium.
One single soft harp and glass-bell note together, pitch A5, round and sweet, gentle shimmering tail, short stone room reverb. One note only, no melody, clean, premium.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: crystal
sounds.keep: Pitched note source (A5) for runes landing and being collected, stepped up the scale per rune. Same reason as chime.
sounds.role: Bonus: rune lands, rune collected.

sounds.name: tumble
sounds.role: Winning symbols burst and vanish (every cascade step). Since 2026-11-11 a real burst: punchy and satisfying, but it plays on every win.

prompts: Winning symbols burst apart: an instant punchy magical explosion of spectral energy at the very first millisecond, a crisp crackle and a spray of glassy shards and sparkles flying outwards, a quick whoosh, gone in half a second. Satisfying, rewarding, exciting. Clean, polished, premium slot-game sound in a small stone crypt, short tail; no synths, no electronic bleeps, no voices.

A glowing gem shatters in a burst of light: an instant sharp crack and a soft deep thump together, bright crystal fragments scattering with a sparkle, a short airy whoosh. Punchy, satisfying, half a second. Clean, polished, premium slot-game sound in a small stone crypt, short tail; no synths, no electronic bleeps, no voices.

Ghost symbols explode into green spirit fire: an instant snappy fireball pop with a crackle of embers, a glittering sparkle burst and a fast whoosh outwards, under one second. Punchy, rewarding, clean. Clean, polished, premium slot-game sound in a small stone crypt, short tail; no synths, no electronic bleeps, no voices.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: charge
sounds.role: The small VS symbol charges up, right before it bursts into a VS reel.

prompts: A one-second crescendo that starts almost silent and grows steadily louder and higher until the very last moment: a string tremolo rising in pitch, a timpani roll getting faster and louder, a choir swelling, then cut off instantly at its loudest point. Cinematic orchestral fighting-game charge-up, no synths, no words.

Rising tension swell for one second: from near silence to full volume, a fast ascending harp and string run over a building drum roll and a rushing wind that grows stronger, the loudest moment is the very end, where it stops abruptly. Cinematic orchestral, no synths, no words.

judge.note: must end at its loudest, the burst follows

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: burst
sounds.role: The VS reel bursts open. Also reused, slightly higher (rate 1.15), as the slam that starts a duel.

prompts: Cinematic fighting-game VS impact: an instant massive taiko and orchestral bass-drum boom with a bright steel sword ring on top, a full brass and choir stab and a shockwave whoosh, short big crypt reverb tail. Epic, aggressive, no synths, no words.

Huge versus-screen slam: an instant thunderous timpani and low brass hit, a sharp metallic shing, a burst of shimmering spectral air and a short dark reverb tail. Epic cinematic orchestral, no electronic sounds, no words.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: clash
sounds.role: Two duel fighters collide: a fighting-game sword and punch impact; harder and lower the higher the stakes.

prompts: Two cursed blades clashing hard in a cinematic duel: an instant bright steel-on-steel ring over a heavy taiko body hit and a short whoosh, punchy with a short tail. Aggressive, satisfying, no voices.
Duel impact: an instant heavy punch of a low orchestral drum layered with a ringing sword clang and a quick spark crackle, dry and punchy, short tail. Cinematic fighting-game hit, no voices.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: wail
sounds.role: A duel fighter is knocked out (the other one wins the round): a fighting-game K.O. hit (the file keeps its old name).

prompts: Cinematic knockout: an instant huge final impact of taiko, timpani and low brass, a sword shattering, a slow-motion boom and a short ghostly breath of wind fading away, dark crypt tail. Decisive, epic, not comic, no words.

Final K.O. blow: an instant colossal orchestral hit with a cracking stone impact, a descending string swipe and a fading spectral wail made of wind (not a voice), short dark tail. Epic, decisive, no words.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: toll
sounds.role: Deep bell toll. Also played an octave up (rate 2) under character wins and crate landings.
sounds.pitched: A2 (110 Hz): retune the chosen take to exactly A2; reject takes more than 1 semitone off or with more than one strike

gen.prompt: A single deep haunted church bell toll, one strike only, note A2, long ringing decay with a dark cathedral reverb. Powerful, ominous, majestic, high-quality professional recording.

sounds.keep: ElevenLabs ignored the note (2 takes came out around E, 5 semitones off); the designed toll is exactly A2, which the game needs because it also plays it an octave up under wins.

sounds.name: sting
sounds.role: Duel won by the pirate (tier 2 multipliers x20-x100): the music dips under it.

prompts: Victory sting in A major, root note A: an instant bright French horn and trumpet hit on an A major chord, a fast celesta and harp run up A, C sharp, E, A, a warm wordless choir ah and a sprinkle of gold coins, short crypt reverb. Triumphant, cinematic, short, clean.

Short heroic win sting in A major: a snare flam into a full brass and strings A major chord, a glockenspiel sparkle on top, a soft choir swell and a few coins clinking. Rewarding, cinematic orchestral, clean, no words.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: sting_devil
sounds.role: The devil wins a duel (x150-x1000), the devil enters as challenger (rate 0.92), and the layer on top of the max win.

prompts: The devil arrives, in A minor: an instant low brass and pipe organ stab, a deep tam-tam swell, a dark cello and contrabassoon line and a breathy wicked chuckle (no words), short dark crypt tail. Big, cinematic, villainous but fun, not horror.

Villain entrance in A minor: a thunderous timpani hit, menacing low horns and trombones in a descending figure, a sinister wordless choir and a crackle of fire, dark crypt reverb. Dramatic cinematic orchestral, fun, not horror, no words.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: fanfare
sounds.role: Free spins (Ghost Crates bonus) triggered: the music dips 2.2 s under it. (The Total Win screen has its own sound now: totalwin.)

prompts: Free spins triggered, root note A, A minor: starts instantly with a big timpani and taiko hit, a sweeping harp and celesta run, bold French horns on an A minor chord and a wordless choir swell, ending on a deep bell on A. Exciting, mysterious, cinematic, about two seconds.

Bonus unlocked, A minor: an instant orchestral cymbal swell and bass-drum boom into a fast rising string run, a heroic horn call ending on A and a glittering glockenspiel and choir sparkle. Epic, rewarding, cinematic, about two seconds, no words.

finish._why: the chosen take has half a second of silence between the explosion and the bells

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: bigwin
sounds.role: Big win (20x bet or more): a money payout. The max win adds sting_devil on top. The music dips 3-4 s.

prompts: Big win, A major: starts at full volume at the very first millisecond with a huge orchestral hit (cymbal crash, timpani and brass on an A major chord), then soaring French horns, a joyful wordless choir, ringing bells and a long cascade of gold coins pouring onto stone. Euphoric, cinematic, premium, no words, no synths.

Huge slot win celebration in A major: an instant loud brass and orchestra stab with a bass drum hit right at the start, then sparkling celesta and glockenspiel runs, a triumphant horn melody and a shower of clinking gold coins, crypt reverb. Triumphant, cinematic, no words, no synths.

sounds.name: totalwin
sounds.role: Total Win screen after the free spins (after the win tiers): a happy, warm celebration of the whole bonus. The music dips 3.5 s under it.

prompts: Total win celebration after the bonus, A major: starts instantly with a bright brass fanfare, sweeping strings climbing up, a joyful wordless choir on a big A major chord, harp and celesta sparkles and gold coins, ending on a warm resolved chord. Happy, grand, cinematic, no words.

Treasure counted, A major: an instant orchestral hit into a heroic horn melody, bright glockenspiel and harp flourishes, a swelling choir and a final big A major chord with a cymbal swell and coins. Warm, rewarding, cinematic, no words.

finish._why: new: the Total Win played the fanfare before, so it starts at that loudness

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: fs_land
sounds.role: An FS (scatter) symbol lands; the loudest effect, each further FS in a spin 2 semitones higher (up to an octave). v4 (2026-11-10): orchestral, to match the new cinematic music.
sounds.note: The current file is built from an ElevenLabs download (audio-src/Magical_scatter_symb_#4...mp3) and peaks at +0.8 dBFS (clips). Check under which plan it was generated.

prompts: Bonus symbol slams onto the reel: an instant hard, sharp strike at the very first millisecond, a bright glockenspiel and anvil-like metal hit on the note A layered over a tight orchestral bass-drum and taiko impact, then a short shimmering ring on A. Crisp, punchy, exciting, clean, premium slot game, no synths, no voices.

Scatter symbol lands: a crack-sharp orchestral hit with a snare-like snap and a timpani punch at the very first millisecond, a ringing tubular bell and celesta note on A on top, short bright sparkle tail, dry crypt room. Exciting, crisp, clean, no synths, no voices.

A treasure symbol hits the reel hard: an instant bright metallic clang and glass bell ping on A, a punchy low drum hit underneath, a fast sparkle of celesta, about one second, tight and dry. Sharp, rewarding, premium, no synths, no voices.

judge.note: must still sound good an octave up: not too much extreme high end

finish._why: the game plays it up to an octave higher; the bright top would turn shrill

sounds.name: edge
sounds.role: Tease: one FS away, under each teasing reel (2.4 s body plus tail), a semitone higher per further reel; the music dips.

prompts: A slow suspense crescendo for a slot game near-miss, three and a half seconds: very quiet at the start, growing louder and higher steadily, string tremolo and violins rising, a timpani roll accelerating, the loudest moment at two and a half seconds, then a sudden stop with a short shimmer. Mid-range orchestral strings, bright enough for phone speakers, no bass rumble, no synths.

Near-miss tension: a rising violin and viola tremolo that climbs in pitch and volume for two and a half seconds, pizzicato strings accelerating, a soft choir rising, peaking at two and a half seconds then cutting off into a faint glassy shimmer. Cinematic, mid-range, clear on small speakers, no bass rumble, no synths.

sounds.direction: v4 (2026-11-11): cinematic orchestral, matches the v4 music

sounds.name: connect
sounds.role: A winning group connects: one pop per symbol as the link reaches it, rising along the group (new, 2026-11-10).

use.frequency: every win, once per winning symbol

sounds.note: Unpitched sharp pop (2026-11-11: no take came out with a clear note): the game raises its rate cell by cell and plays the chime (exact A5) under it, a scale step higher per cell, so the connection climbs a melody.

prompts: One single sharp, bright plucked note at A5: a crisp pizzicato violin and celesta struck together with a tiny glass ping on the attack, the hit starts at the very first millisecond, short clean ring of a quarter second. One note only, no melody, no reverb wash. Premium slot-game win sound, clear and punchy.

One single crisp glockenspiel and harp note at A5, struck hard with a bright metallic attack at the very first millisecond, short sparkling ring, dry. One note only, no melody. Sharp, clean, satisfying, premium.

One single bright crystal bell ping at A5 with a hard click of the mallet at the very start, very short and clean ring, dry, no reverb tail. One note only. Sharp, sparkling, satisfying slot-game connection sound.

finish._why: a short pop like the tumble poof, played often

sounds.name: trove
sounds.role: The free spins begin: under the fullscreen 'Enter the Sacred Trove' clip (assets/fs-trove.webm, 6 s): the camera rushes through the crypt, a rune vault door bursts open in light at about 2 s, then the treasure vault is revealed (new, 2026-11-11).

prompts: Cinematic orchestral transition, 6 seconds: a rising rush of wind and ghostly whispers with a swelling string tremolo for two seconds, then a huge deep stone-door boom and a bright burst of shimmering light with a cymbal swell, then a majestic wordless choir 'ah' chord in A major with harp glissando, sparkling celesta and the glitter of gold coins, ringing out in a big crypt reverb. Epic, magical, rewarding. No synths, no words.

Haunted treasure vault opens, 6 seconds: a whooshing rush through swirling ghost wind building fast, an ancient heavy stone door cracking open with a deep timpani and taiko hit at two seconds, a blast of magical shimmer, then a glorious choir and brass swell in A major with tinkling coins and celesta sparkles, long cathedral reverb tail. Cinematic, spooky but triumphant, clean. No synths, no voices with words.

finish._why: a celebration like the free-spin fanfare, which it follows
